```{r}
# build_yield_csv.R
# Consolidate yield_*.nc4 files from each crop subfolder into one long-format CSV.
# Output columns: crop, year, lat, lon, yield

library(ncdf4)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Folder containing this script and the crop subfolders.
# If running interactively in RStudio, set this to your project folder, e.g.:
# project_dir <- "C:/Users/jerem/OneDrive/Documents/Stat 405/Final Project"
project_dir <- getwd()

crops <- c("maize", "maize_major", "maize_second",
           "rice",  "rice_major",  "rice_second",
           "soybean",
           "wheat", "wheat_spring", "wheat_winter")

# Read one .nc4 file -> tibble of valid (non-NA) cells
read_yield_nc <- function(path, crop, year) {
  nc  <- nc_open(path)
  on.exit(nc_close(nc))

  lon <- ncvar_get(nc, "lon")          # length 720, 0.25 .. 359.75
  lat <- ncvar_get(nc, "lat")          # length 360, -89.75 .. 89.75
  v   <- ncvar_get(nc, "var")          # matrix [lon, lat]
  fv  <- ncatt_get(nc, "var", "_FillValue")$value
  if (!is.null(fv)) v[v == fv] <- NA

  # Mark valid cells, pull their indices, build a tidy frame.
  idx <- which(!is.na(v), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(idx) == 0) return(NULL)

  lon_vals <- lon[idx[, 1]]
  # Convert 0..360 -> -180..180
  lon_vals <- ifelse(lon_vals > 180, lon_vals - 360, lon_vals)

  tibble(
    crop  = crop,
    year  = year,
    lat   = lat[idx[, 2]],
    lon   = lon_vals,
    yield = v[idx]
  )
}

# Walk every crop folder and every yearly file.
all_files <- list()
for (crop in crops) {
  crop_dir <- file.path(project_dir, crop)
  files <- list.files(crop_dir, pattern = "^yield_\\d{4}\\.nc4$", full.names = TRUE)
  message("Reading ", length(files), " files from ", crop)
  for (f in files) {
    year <- as.integer(sub("^yield_(\\d{4})\\.nc4$", "\\1", basename(f)))
    all_files[[length(all_files) + 1]] <- read_yield_nc(f, crop, year)
  }
}

yields <- bind_rows(all_files)
#message("Total rows: ", nrow(yields))
#write_csv(yields, file.path(project_dir, "all_crop_yields.csv"))
#message("Wrote all_crop_yields.csv (", nrow(yields), " rows)")
```

```{r}
yield_by_crop_year <- yields %>%
  group_by(crop, year) %>%
  summarise(yield = sum(yield, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(crop, year)
```
